description: SYNTHORA noaa-tides: tide and water level for US ports/stations, VERIFIED by crossing NOAA harmonic prediction with the LIVE observation at the same station — the anomaly (observed minus predicted) is the storm-surge/port-disruption signal. Source: NOAA CO-OPS official, free, no key. $0.005 USDC x402 Base. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]
